Lighting and shadows are consistent. Additionally, the right motorcycle exhibits minor geometric fusion artifacts around the rear wheel/swingarm area. The segmentation mask (636_mask) shows fragmented boundaries for the right motorcycle, corroborating structural instability in that region. Despite these issues, overall visual fidelity remains high.
